name: Chikaranomoto Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Chikaranomoto Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of ramen specialty stores, restaurants, and food courts. The company operates through three segments: Domestic Store Management Business, Overseas Store Management Business, and Product Sales Business. It manufactures and sells soba, udon, and ramen noodles, as well as soups, sauces, broths, seasonings, and other food ingredients under the Ippudo, Najimatei, Inaba Udon, Kaeda, Kanada, Watanabe Seimen, and RAMEN EXPRESS brand names. The company also provides planning and design support services; and management of various events and technical training classes. It serves commercial and general consumers. …
